signals.text: [Uruguayan maritime authorities: 48 hours permitted, extendable for repairs]
signals.zh: 乌拉圭海事当局口头准许停留 48 小时，可因修理延长；朗斯多夫要求 14 天。

signals.text: [To British Minister: delay Graf Spee's departure by every means — sail British ships, invoke the 24-hour rule]
signals.zh: 哈伍德请英国公使米林顿-德雷克用一切办法拖延施佩伯爵号出港：让英国商船出港，援引「24 小时规则」。

signals.text: [Uruguay extends the stay to 72 hours — to expire 20:00 local time, 17 December]
signals.zh: 乌拉圭政府把停留期延长到 72 小时，至 17 日当地时间 20:00 届满，否则拘留。
我的目标：歼灭。——哈伍德致各舰的方针电（时间组 1135/15）：坎伯兰号白天在蒙得维的亚外显露身影。

signals.text: Strategic position off Montevideo: besides the cruisers and destroyers, Ark Royal and Renown. Close blockade at night. Escape into open sea and break-through to home waters hopeless.
signals.zh: 蒙得维的亚外的态势：除巡洋舰与驱逐舰外还有皇家方舟号与声望号，夜间严密封锁，冲向大洋、突破回国无望。拟驶到中立水域边界，若能以剩余弹药打出一条路就去布宜诺斯艾利斯。请决定：河口水浅仍应自沉，还是宁可被拘留？

signals.text: [You may engage Graf Spee anywhere outside the three-mile limit]
signals.zh: 海军部 0219/16：可在三海里领海线以外的任何地点与施佩伯爵号交战。

signals.text: 1. Attempt by all means to extend the time in neutral waters in order to guarantee freedom of action as long as possible. 2. Approved: Fight your way through to Buenos Aires if possible. 3. No internment in Uruguay. Attempt effective destruction if ship is scuttled.
signals.zh: 一、尽一切办法延长在中立水域的时间，以尽可能保持行动自由。二、同意：如有可能，杀出一条路去布宜诺斯艾利斯。三、不得在乌拉圭被拘留。若自沉，务求彻底破坏。——雷德尔（无线电 1347/16，柏林时间 17:07）

signals.text: [His Majesty has been graciously pleased to appoint Commodore Harwood KCB and promote him Rear-Admiral; Captains Bell, Woodhouse and Parry CB]
signals.zh: 国王授予哈伍德巴斯勋章（KCB）并晋升海军少将（自 13 日起），贝尔、伍德豪斯、帕里三位舰长获 CB 勋位。哈伍德当晚通报各舰。

signals.text: As Envoy reports impossibility of extending time limit, instructions 2 and 3 of radiogram 1347/16 remain in force.
signals.zh: 公使报告无法延长期限，故 1347/16 号电第二、三项继续有效。（无线电 2239/16，柏林时间 17 日 00:40）

signals.text: [Report from shore: Graf Spee transferring 300–400 men to German ship Tacoma]
signals.zh: 岸上报告：施佩伯爵号正把三四百人转到德国货轮塔科马号上；17:20 又报已转移 700 余人及行李。

signals.text: [Graf Spee left harbour, proceeding west; Tacoma following]
signals.zh: 施佩伯爵号出港西行，塔科马号跟随。分舰队以 25 节驶向惠斯尔浮标，各舰进入战位。

signals.text: Graf Spee has blown herself up.
signals.zh: 施佩伯爵号已经自爆。——阿贾克斯号飞机报告（当地时间 19:54）。

signals.text: [Log entry: Admiral Graf Spee decommissioned 17 December 1939, 20:00]
signals.zh: 朗斯多夫令记入航海日志：「施佩伯爵海军上将号于 1939 年 12 月 17 日 20:00 退役。」

signals.text: [Letter to the German Ambassador, Buenos Aires, dated 19 Dec: he alone bears responsibility for the scuttling and will prove by his death that the fighting services of the Third Reich are ready to die for the honour of the flag]
signals.zh: 朗斯多夫留给驻阿根廷大使的信：自沉的责任由他一人承担，他将以死证明德国军人愿为军旗的荣誉而死。随后在布宜诺斯艾利斯的寓所中自杀。
